newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia official says no Bre-X deal yet.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia official says no Bre-X deal yet.

text.p: An Indonesian mining official said on Wednesday the Mines and Energy Ministry still had received no word on a deal between Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and gold mining giant Barrick Gold Corp to develop the Busang gold find.

The mining department had called a news conference for noon (0500 GMT) in Jakarta which was expected to cover a deal between the two companies to develop the huge Busang deposit in Indonesia's Kalimantan province.
The secretary-general of the mines department, Umar Said, told reporters 90 minutes later that he had not yet received any information on a deal.
He said the two companies were supposed to report back on Wednesday to meet a government imposed December 4 deadline, but, so far, had not done so.
If they did not reach a deal, "the government will take steps to expedite development of Busang", he said.
